definitions.gloss: to run into difficulties; to make slow progress; to be stalled
definitions.explanation: To encounter obstacles that slow or halt progress. Originally a nautical term meaning rough sailing, now widely used for negotiations, projects, and any process that hits snags.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{難航|なんこう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{人手不足|ひとでぶそく}→人手不足：11436_hitodebusoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{難航|なんこう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The construction is having difficulties due to a labor shortage.

examples.japanese: {与野党|よやとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}して→対立する：22172_tairitsusuru⟧、⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{審議|しんぎ}→審議：19112_shingi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難航|なんこう}→難航：14584_nankou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}めている→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧。
examples.english: With the ruling and opposition parties at odds, deliberation on the bill is facing extreme difficulties.

notes:
Originally a nautical term — ⟦{難|なん}→難：00452_nan⟧ (difficulty) + {航|こう} (voyage) — meaning a rough sea crossing. Now used almost exclusively in the figurative sense of any process encountering serious obstacles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{難航|なんこう}する — negotiations hit difficulties
- ⟦{審議|しんぎ}→審議：19112_shingi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{難航|なんこう}する — deliberations stall
- ⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{難航|なんこう}する — coordination runs into trouble
- ⟦{難航|なんこう}→難航：14584_nankou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{極|きわ}める→極める：13139_kiwameru⟧ — to face extreme difficulties
- ⟦{難航|なんこう}→難航：14584_nankou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予想|よそう}される→予想する：06064_yosousuru⟧ — difficulties are expected

USAGE:
Very common in news reporting, especially about political negotiations, business deals, and large projects. The noun form ⟦{難航|なんこう}→難航：14584_nankou⟧ is also used without ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: ⟦{難航|なんこう}→難航：14584_nankou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (difficulties continue).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{行|い}き{詰|づ}まる→行き詰まる：09346_ikizumaru⟧ — to reach a deadlock (more complete stoppage)
- ⟦{苦戦|くせん}→苦戦：13990_kusen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to struggle, fight an uphill battle (more about effort)
- ⟦{停滞|ていたい}する→停滞する：26992_teitaisuru⟧ — to stagnate (emphasizes lack of movement)
